literal: Courage, subjects protecting, having learned knowing, with effort, five together that which is excellent [is] ministry.
translation: A ministry is that which possesses excellence in these five qualities together: courage, protecting the subjects, learning, understanding, and industriousness.
modern: அஞ்சாமை, குடிமக்களைக் காத்தல், நூல்களைக் கற்றல், அறிய வேண்டியவற்றை அறிதல், விடாமுயற்சி ஆகிய ஐந்தும் ஒருங்கே சிறப்பாக அமைந்ததே அமைச்சாகும்.
explanation: This couplet defines the five essential qualities that make up an excellent minister or ministry. The word 'வன்கண்' can sometimes mean harshness or cruelty, but in the context of statecraft here, it means the courage and firm resolve needed to govern and face challenges. The other qualities are protecting the people ('குடி காத்தல்'), acquiring knowledge ('கற்று'), understanding situations clearly ('அறிதல்'), and tireless effort ('ஆள்வினை'). The phrase 'ஐந்துடன் மாண்டது' emphasizes that true ministerial excellence requires all five of these traits to be present together.
